title: Stage 08 — Intermediate walking evidence · NOT ACCEPTED
platform: Superseded candidate 197ab630793e · production browser and partial Windows-native evidence
summary: INTERMEDIATE RECORD, NOT FINAL ACCEPTANCE. Solid walking boundaries, real stairs and working doors passed bounded production-browser journeys, but this candidate failed tablet layout checks and its complete Windows-native journey did not pass. The old floating hand and cluttered starting map are preserved here as the before state. Clean plans, the requested picker title, an attached arm and layout refinements belong to Stage 09 and require new release proof. No A–Z requirement is marked complete by this report.

requirements.change: Actual candidate screenshots show door-card/navigation-hint overlap: 22.17 px at 1024 × 768 and 4.78 px at 768 × 1024. Controls remained present, but the layout failed.
requirements.remaining: A corrected candidate must pass both orientations. This report does not accept tablet support. No physical tablet or native macOS/Linux testing is claimed; phone QA remains excluded.

requirements.change: The original 169-command Windows scenario exited 1 at a stair-picker fixture near a support edge. Integer native pointer coordinates selected an invalid point. A separate 76-command recovery passed in 16.191 seconds after moving the test point inward.
requirements.remaining: Recovery is not a fresh complete native pass. Preserve the original failure and verify the new picker projection in the next candidate. Five lower controls and normal exit were exercised in recovery; no full catalogue acceptance.

requirements.change: E and the visible door button operated real door transforms with busy and step-clear feedback. This candidate still shows the old detached hand and the old detailed-triangle picker.
requirements.remaining: Stage 09 must verify the exact title “Pick your walkthrough starting point”, a clean aligned plan, attached-arm presentation and readable tablet overlays. Do not treat development-only refinements as released here.
